# [P2] Finalize the distribution deck before PDF export

## Why

Current break in output ordering: `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py:2835` runs post-distribution generators, including PDF export, before `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py:647` appends the optional concentration slide. With export_pdf and include_concentration_table_in_ppt enabled, the real fixture pipeline passes a 23-slide deck to the PDF export generator but finishes with a 24-slide PPTX. The PDF transport was intercepted for the proof; no Windows PDF renderer ran. The exported source provably lacks a slide present in the final presentation. Standalone validation also runs before this final mutation at `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py:2807`.

## Scope

Finalize the optional distribution concentration slide before validating the final deck and invoking its downstream export generators.

## Non-Goals

No concentration formula changes, unrelated generator redesign, or changes to the master deck contract. Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: reordering a helper without proving final deck parity at the actual PDF generator boundary is a failure of this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py`, place concentration-slide finalization before final distribution validation and PDF generator invocation, retaining exactly one appended slide.
- [ ] In `tests/pipeline/test_monthly_pipeline_ppt_outputs.py`, add test_final_concentration_slide_precedes_pdf_export through the actual pipeline with only the PDF transport intercepted; compare source slide count and concentration-table content at export with the final PPTX.
- [ ] In `tests/pipeline/test_monthly_pipeline_ppt_outputs.py`, add controls with concentration disabled and PDF disabled, asserting existing output behavior and no duplicate slides.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/pipeline/test_monthly_pipeline_ppt_outputs.py -q` passes with test_final_concentration_slide_precedes_pdf_export collected; both the final distribution and export source have 24 slides in the synthetic fixture, including the same concentration table.
- [ ] Final standalone validation runs after the last distribution mutation; validation failures still prevent reporting successful output.
- [ ] Deliberate-break gate: restore the old ordering in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py`; test_final_concentration_slide_precedes_pdf_export must fail on the 23-versus-24 mismatch; revert the break and rerun the named test to pass, retaining both logs.

## Implementation Notes

Verified audit work order filed 2026-09-14. Independent lead-final-deck-proof.py ran the real fixture pipeline and actual PPTX appender while recording the source supplied to PDFExportGenerator.generate. Observed 23 slides at export versus 24 in the final PPTX. A Windows follow-up must confirm the resulting rendered PDF has the same concentration slide; the local proof makes no claim to COM or PDF rendering validation.
title: [P2] Finalize the distribution deck before PDF export

## Why

`src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py:575` is current evidence at current main 7c01963cb4173128c806347e622ed43a08fdcf4a. Current break: concentration uses input rows as independent counterparties, although `docs/concentration_metrics.md:28` defines Top-N by counterparty. Alpha split into 60+60 and ten other names at 10 yields HHI 0.16942149 and Top5 0.68181818. A pre-aggregated Alpha=120 control yields HHI 0.31818182 and Top5 0.72727273. The actual pipeline reshaper preserves split rows, so representation alone changes reported concentration.

## Scope

Aggregate gross exposure for each counterparty within variant and segment before ranking; preserve the existing sign convention and supported group_by API.

## Non-Goals

No upstream workflow changes, model redesign, or unrelated refactors. Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: adding a helper or a test double that leaves consolidate counterparties before concentration calculations unimplemented is a failure of this issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
